# SkillBridge frontend instructions

- Use React, TypeScript strict mode, Vite, Tailwind CSS v4, React Router, and Lucide React.
- Keep shared UI in `src/components`, feature pages in `src/features`, mock data in `src/data`, and backend clients in `src/services`.
- Do not add AWS credentials or pretend mock data is connected to a backend.
- Prefer accessible, responsive UI with indigo and violet accents and reusable components.
